T01.rationale: Founder's career (Citadel, Head of ML at Quora, VP Eng at Addepar, prior AI start-up) is documented, and Lighter led perp-DEX monthly volume within ~3 months of public mainnet; the founder's earlier company outcome is not documented.

T03.rationale: A ~28-engineer team is reported only in a write-up the team reviewed; public communication centres on the CEO and no ops/security leads or succession are documented.

T04.rationale: In-house team designed custom ZK circuits for verifiable matching, reviewed by zkSecurity since 2024, and published the prover code in Dec 2025; no specs or research papers of its own.

T05.rationale: Open allegations at TGE: an LLP-linked 5-wallet cluster received ~10M LIT and sold ~2.76M, and a market maker reportedly got >$24M of LIT; the CEO said the wallets were a third-party LP with no undisclosed ties. No enforcement found in coverage.

T07.rationale: A US C-Corp issues LIT and runs the protocol; there is no token-holder vote, the network governor is an EOA (a team multisig acting as security council can skip the 21-day upgrade delay), and decentralisation via staking is described only as 'progressive'.

T08.rationale: Treasury Account #0 is public on the explorer (180,588 LIT on 5 Jan), but no buyback amounts, reports, or custody details for the 250M-LIT ecosystem reserve are published.

T09.rationale: Nov-2025 round led by Founders Fund and Ribbit with Haun and Robinhood; a16z, Dragonfly, Lightspeed, Coatue and Coinbase also listed as backers. Investor token warrants (24% of supply) make them a 2027+ supply source.

P01.rationale: Premium (low-latency) accounts pay real fees, ~$105–200M annualised; but retail volume is free and was largely farmed for points, so demand outside incentives is unproven.

P02.rationale: Public mainnet since early Oct 2025 (~3.5 months at listing) after a 2025 private beta; spot trading and staking added Dec 2025–Jan 2026.

P03.rationale: Original design: an app-specific Ethereum ZK-rollup whose custom Plonky2 circuits prove order matching and liquidations, not a fork; no peer-reviewed research.

P04.rationale: Sequencer database failed for ~4.5h in the 10 Oct 2025 crash (known weak point, upgrade postponed), and the prover lagged the sequencer on 30 Dec, delaying withdrawals.

P05.rationale: Single operator runs sequencer and prover; Ethereum is the settlement/DA layer with a 14-day desert-mode fallback; fast exits route via Arbitrum. Oracle sources were not documented in dated sources.

gates.title: Unrestricted mint controlled by a single key
gates.why: Supply can be inflated at will; every other number in the report is conditional on one person's restraint.

gates.title: Sanctions / illicit-finance exposure
gates.why: Listing would create direct regulatory liability for the venue.

gates.title: Core contracts not source-verified
gates.why: Nobody outside the team can see what users are interacting with.

gates.title: Unremediated exploit with user losses
gates.why: Users are owed money; listing would expose new users to the same counterparty.

gates.title: Active enforcement action against the project or founders
gates.why: Outcome could force delisting or freeze assets after listing.

gates.title: Upgradeable contracts with no meaningful timelock
gates.why: Logic can change under users with no time to exit.

gates.title: Extreme holder concentration
gates.why: A handful of wallets can set the price; order books will not absorb their exit.

gates.title: Unlock cliff within 90 days
gates.why: More than a quarter of circulating supply unlocks shortly after a listing window.

gates.title: No independent audit
gates.why: Code holding user funds has never been reviewed by a third party.

gates.title: Material misrepresentation
gates.why: Two or more project claims contradicted by observed data — the reviewer cannot rely on anything self-reported.

gates.title: Security pillar failing
gates.why: Average security score below 1.5/4 — structural rather than one-off weakness.

gates.title: Anonymous team with centralised admin powers
Undisclosed market-maker terms
gates.why: Token loans and call options are where post-listing dumps are engineered.

gates.title: Insider-heavy allocation
gates.why: Team and investors hold more than half of supply.

gates.title: Mercenary TVL
gates.why: Most deposits are paid to be there and will leave when incentives stop.

gates.title: Volume implausible versus depth
gates.why: Daily volume more than 100x the ±2% depth is a common wash-trading signature.

verdict_reasons: evidence coverage 61% below the 70% needed for a verdict
